chrome_hint: eBay AU sold listings: 'railway tail lamp', 'railway rear lamp oil', 'British Railways tail lamp lantern'; also 'Victorian Railways lamp', 'SAR railway lamp', 'NSWGR lamp'. Check Terapeak, and Leski, Gibson's, Lawsons, Theodore Bruce, Carter's for railwayana sold results.
viewing_check: Look for stamped or embossed railway initials or maker name on the body, lens rim, bracket pocket, burner and underside (VR, SAR, NSWGR, TGR, BR, Oldfield, Lucas). A marked Australian railway lamp is worth materially more. Check lens for cracks and whether burner, wick and red/green glass slides are present.
